title: Button telemetry schema and token lineage for regression harness
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background: We have recurring visual regressions and theme mismatches in button variants (primary/ghost/soft) across releases. Root causes often trace to token churn (token renames/fallbacks) or missed UX edge-cases (cancelable loading states, icon-only focus frames). Existing QA catches problems late.

Goal: Define a lightweight telemetry schema and token-lineage mapping that instrument button components to emit structured events useful for: a) automated visual/regression detectors, b) token usage analysis, and c) rollout safety checks for theme/token changes. This ticket captures the design-side spec, acceptance criteria, and coordination handoff for engineering implementation and dashboarding.

Scope: design schema for events, list of tokens to map to semantic names, suggested sampling rules (dev/debug vs prod), UI-level annotation contract for when components should emit events (render, hover, press, loading-start, loading-cancel, disabled-render, theme-switch), and a minimal dashboard spec for regression alerts. Does not implement analytics plumbing or dashboards; that is in ENG tasks (see dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: A telemetry event contract (JSON schema) exists and is reviewed by Eng and Product; includes event types, required fields, and optional debug payload.
A token-lineage CSV mapping token names (legacy and current) to semantic roles (e.g., button.bg.primary, button.fg.disabled) is published in the design repo.
Design authoring guidelines updated: when to emit events from components and how to annotate new tokens to ensure lineage continuity.
A short demo design doc and Figma annotations show example flows (primary button loading -> cancel -> fallback label) with event points annotated.
Hand-off note with links to ENG PR template and example telemetry payloads placed in Confluence; engineering dependency acknowledged.
QA checklist for visual/regression tests created to use telemetry markers for targeted snapshot comparisons.
tasks: Write telemetry event contract (fields, types, allowable values)
Identify and map 40+ button tokens into semantic roles and record legacy aliases
Update design tokens doc with migration guidance and breakage risk levels
Annotate Figma components with event hook locations and example payloads
Run internal design review with Eng and Product; collect feedback and iterate
